text: On 6 March 2022, a militant threw a grenade at a marketplace located on Hari Singh High Street in Srinagar, Indian-administered Jammu and Kashmir, near the Amira Kadal bridge, at approximately 4:20 P.M. The attack injured twenty-four people and killed two. The street was crowded with a large number of individuals at the time of the bombing. The terrorist targeted security forces, injuring dozens of people, including at least one policeman. Later that day, 60-year-old Muhammad Aslam Makdhoomi from Nowhatta died from his injuries. The 19-year-old Rafiya Jan passed away the following day. The attack drew widespread condemnation across India, including from Manoj Sinha, Farooq and Omar Abdullah, Mehbooba Mufti, the Jammu Kashmir Pradesh Congress Committee, the Bharatiya Janata Party, and other prominent figures.
